review_rework_resolved.resolution: The public ingestion API now accepts an explicit reproducible archive provider and stable provider identity. The seed CLI configures a content-addressed local JSON archive provider, requires complete historical boundaries, and never enables a live fallback. An offline end-to-end regression passes the archive through the real loader and processor into the V2 adapter while asserting both live fetch methods are unused.

Checkpoint identity now binds normalized temporal bounds, dataset, hashed provider identity, Vector adapter/schema/table/RPC, embedding model/version/cache schema, and ordered document/evidence/chunk identity manifests. Persisted checkpoints contain safe hashes and counts only. Resume re-materializes and validates the exact snapshot; provider, content, embedding, or adapter changes fail closed before Graph can mix materializations or Vector work can be falsely reused.

Processor deduplication now suppresses only an exact immutable evidence observation. Same-content distinct document versions, dataset versions, retrieval times, and effective-time observations retain distinct evidence and chunk identities.

Ingestion lifecycle telemetry uses the explicit versioned control identity Stage 03 revision 1 attempt 3. The existing compact allowlist, monotonic latency, status/count/degraded metadata, and sanitized deterministic error codes remain enforced and sentinel-tested.

snapshot_contract.resume_policy: Only an exact materialization may reuse completed Vector work or retry Graph; any missing or mismatched fingerprint fails closed.
snapshot_contract.persisted_payload: Safe identifiers, hashes, counts, stage status, normalized boundaries, and sanitized error codes only; no raw document text, URL, provider identity, exception payload, or secret.
